description: dev-guardian guardrails — secret detection on writes, catastrophic-command blocking on Bash and PowerShell, install-time package vetting on npm/pnpm/yarn/bun/pip/uv/poetry/composer/dotnet install commands (denies nonexistent or malicious packages, 3 s network budget), the hook configuration and Claude Code's settings guarded from Write/Edit and third-party MCP write tools, and a security-posture briefing at session start. Dependency-free and fail-open; exec form (Claude Code 2.1.139 or later); tune via .guardian/hooks.config.json (project files may only make it stricter) or disable with GUARDIAN_HOOKS=off (package vetting alone: GUARDIAN_PKG_VET=0).
